harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-24: zoo owner, "the breadth mixed strategy has a lot of parameters to tune as well, do experiments with those too" (borg-zoo#769).
experiment.prespecified: Fixed 2026-11-24, before any result (Rule 22, #758). One dial per arm against ctl, shipped values otherwise, classes-18, evidence not retained. Overlap note: explore_mix_radius (2, 5), explore_mix_step (1) and explore_mix_max_clevel (30) are dialled in reborn-dials-head; this experiment covers the walk's remaining four dials, two-sided. Deaths-0 constraint (owner, #783): an arm whose deaths rise cannot be adopted however fast it levels. Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's value in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; identical plays per arm. Progress endpoint CL5 reached by 100,000 turns - known attainment out of all starts, deaths, unfinished and alive at the cutoff with CL5 reported separately; DL3/DL5 and level arrival as diagnostics; the turn of first reaching character level 5 where recorded. Report per arm against ctl: the CL5 endpoint, paired CL5 gained/lost (exact McNemar), deaths and causes, identical plays. A dial that plays ctl's keys was not exercised and gets no ladder. Descriptive (RULES 14); ladders on the owner's word.
